unitTitle: Adjectives/Order of Adjectives/Comparisons - Expressing Certainty - Will

pairsWith.noteUz: Sifatlar tartibi mashqlari va must/can't (ishonchli taxmin).

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 3-UNIT MAShQLAR, 3-BET (17-bet, PDF 16). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '3'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Order of Adjectives':
7) 'Put the adjectives in the correct order to describe the objects, as in the example.' SURATLAR: 1 yog'och qoshiq - a/wooden/spoon/long/light brown; 2 ko'k sochiq - a/blue/cotton/big/towel; 3 qora charm tufli - a(n)/leather/expensive/pair of shoes; 4 oq-oltin likopcha - a/white and golden/china/beautiful/round/plate; 5 kumush shamdon - a/heavy/silver/candlestick/tall; 6 sariq o'rdakcha - a/yellow/cute/plastic/little/duck. Namuna: a long, light brown, wooden spoon
8) 'Write five true sentences about things you have in your room or items of clothing you wear as in the example.' I always wear soft white leather training shoes.
9) 'Read the following letter and put the adjectives into the correct order.' Xat: Dear Sir/Madam, I recently stayed for three days at your hotel in room 23. I believe I left a(n) 1) ...... (brown/expensive/leather/purse) in my room. It has a(n) 2) ...... (silk/red/shiny/lining) and there is a(n) 3) ...... (metal/small/round lock) on the top. There wasn't much money inside, but it contained a lot of 4) ...... (photos/old/precious). I am almost sure I left it on the 5) ...... (table/square/wooden) or under the 6) ...... (small/lovely/sofa/green) in the corner. If you find it, please return it to me as soon as possible. Yours faithfully, James Stuart

O'NG USTUN - 'Expressing Certainty':
10) 'Look at the pictures and make sentences using must/can't, as in the example.' SURATLAR: 1 bolalar sinfda qo'l ko'targan - they / on holiday / at school → They can't be on holiday. They must be at school. 2 qiz dengiz bo'yida kitob o'qiyapti - she / at work / on holiday. 3 odamlar ofisda yig'ilishda - they / at café / at work. 4 ayol qorda issiq kiyimda - it hot outside / cold. 5 odamlar shahar ko'chasida - they / in the country / in the city. 6 bola kompyuterda yozyapti - he / play tennis / type.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '17'.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the adjectives in the correct order to describe the objects, as in the example. Example: a/wooden/spoon/long/light brown → a long, light brown, wooden spoon
exercises.instructionUz: Sifatlarni to'g'ri tartibga qo'yib narsalarni tasvirlang, namunadagidek. Namuna: a/wooden/spoon/long/light brown → a long, light brown, wooden spoon
exercises.explanationUz:
TARTIB: FIKR → O'LChAM → OG'IRLIK
  → ShAKL → RANG → MATERIAL → OT.

  1 a LONG (o'lcham), LIGHT BROWN
    (rang), WOODEN (material) spoon
  2 a BIG (o'lcham), BLUE (rang),
    COTTON (material) towel
  3 an EXPENSIVE (fikr), LEATHER
    (material) pair of shoes
  4 a BEAUTIFUL (fikr), ROUND
    (shakl), WHITE AND GOLDEN
    (rang), CHINA (material) plate
  5 a TALL (o'lcham), HEAVY
    (og'irlik), SILVER (material)
    candlestick
  6 a CUTE (fikr), LITTLE (o'lcham),
    YELLOW (rang), PLASTIC
    (material) duck


⚠ 'A CANDLESTICK':

  = shamdon.


⚠ 'CHINA' (kichik harf):

  = chinni.

items.answer: a long, light brown, wooden spoon
an expensive, leather pair of shoes
a beautiful, round, white and golden, china plate
a cute, little, yellow, plastic duck

exercises.instructionEn: Write five true sentences about things you have in your room or items of clothing you wear as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Xonangizdagi narsalar yoki kiyadigan kiyimlaringiz haqida beshta to'g'ri gap yozing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'ZIM HAQIMDA - 2-3 SIFAT BILAN.

  Namuna: soft (fikr) white (rang)
  leather (material) training
  shoes.

  Tartibga rioya qiling: fikr →
  o'lcham → rang → material.
exercises.exampleEn: I always wear soft white leather training shoes.
exercises.exampleUz: Men har doim yumshoq oq charm sport poyabzal kiyaman.
modelAnswers: I always wear soft white leather training shoes.
I have got a big, brown, wooden desk in my room.
I usually wear a warm, blue, woollen jumper in winter.
There is a small, round, metal clock on my wall.
I have got a comfortable, long, green, cotton T-shirt.
There is a lovely, square, red, plastic box on my desk.
modelAnswersUz: Men har doim yumshoq oq charm sport poyabzal kiyaman. (NAMUNA)
Xonamda katta, jigarrang, yog'och yozuv stoli bor.
Qishda odatda iliq, ko'k, jun sviter kiyaman.
Devorimda kichik, dumaloq, metall soat bor.
Menda qulay, uzun, yashil, paxta futbolka bor.
Stolimda chiroyli, kvadrat, qizil, plastik quti bor.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the following letter and put the adjectives into the correct order.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi xatni o'qing va sifatlarni to'g'ri tartibga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
JEYMS STYUARTNING XATI - yo'qolgan
  hamyon.

  1 an EXPENSIVE, BROWN, LEATHER
    purse (fikr - rang - material)
  2 a SHINY, RED, SILK lining
    (fikr - rang - material)
  3 a SMALL, ROUND, METAL lock
    (o'lcham - shakl - material)
  4 PRECIOUS, OLD photos (fikr -
    yosh)
  5 the SQUARE, WOODEN table
    (shakl - material)
  6 the LOVELY, SMALL, GREEN sofa
    (fikr - o'lcham - rang)


⚠ 'A PURSE':

  = hamyon (ayollar).


⚠ 'LINING':

  = astar.


⚠ 'YOURS FAITHFULLY':

  = hurmat bilan (notanish odamga
  rasmiy xat - 'Dear Sir/Madam'
  bilan).

items.textEn: I believe I left a(n) ___ (brown/expensive/leather/purse) in my room.
and there is a(n) ___ (metal/small/round lock) on the top.
There wasn't much money inside, but it contained a lot of ___ (photos/old/precious).
I am almost sure I left it on the ___ (table/square/wooden)
or under the ___ (small/lovely/sofa/green) in the corner.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and make sentences using must/can't, as in the example. 1 (children in a classroom) they / on holiday / at school → They can't be on holiday. They must be at school. 2 (girl reading by the sea) she / at work / on holiday. 3 (people at a meeting) they / at café / at work. 4 (woman in the snow) it hot outside / cold. 5 (people in a city street) they / in the country / in the city. 6 (boy at a computer) he / play tennis / type.
exercises.instructionUz: Suratlarga qarang va must/can't bilan gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. 1 (bolalar sinfda) they / on holiday / at school → Ular ta'tilda bo'lishi mumkin emas. Ular maktabda bo'lsa kerak. 2 (qiz dengiz bo'yida o'qiyapti) she / at work / on holiday. 3 (odamlar yig'ilishda) they / at café / at work. 4 (ayol qorda) it hot outside / cold. 5 (odamlar shahar ko'chasida) they / in the country / in the city. 6 (bola kompyuterda) he / play tennis / type.
exercises.explanationUz:
MUST / CAN'T - SURATGA QARAB
  XULOSA.

  Birinchi ko'rsatma - NOTO'G'RI →
    CAN'T be ...
  Ikkinchi - TO'G'RI → MUST be ...

  6-surat: fe'l bilan - He can't
  be PLAYING tennis. He must be
  TYPING. (hozir bo'layotgan
  harakat → must be + V-ing)
exercises.exampleEn: 1 They can't be on holiday. They must be at school.
exercises.exampleUz: 1 Ular ta'tilda bo'lishi mumkin emas. Ular maktabda bo'lsa kerak.
modelAnswers: 1 They can't be on holiday. They must be at school.
2 She can't be at work. She must be on holiday.
3 They can't be at a café. They must be at work.
4 It can't be hot outside. It must be cold.
5 They can't be in the country. They must be in the city.
6 He can't be playing tennis. He must be typing.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Ular ta'tilda bo'lishi mumkin emas. Ular maktabda bo'lsa kerak. (NAMUNA)
2 U ishda bo'lishi mumkin emas. U ta'tilda bo'lsa kerak.
3 Ular kafeda bo'lishi mumkin emas. Ular ishda bo'lsa kerak.
4 Tashqarida issiq bo'lishi mumkin emas. Sovuq bo'lsa kerak.
5 Ular qishloqda bo'lishi mumkin emas. Ular shaharda bo'lsa kerak.
6 U tennis o'ynayotgan bo'lishi mumkin emas. U yozayotgan bo'lsa kerak. (must be + V-ing)
